errors.evidence: The Character Attention input line (solid blue) starts at approximately 0.1 at layer 0, not 0.2.

errors.text_span: fluctuates between 0.6 and 0.75 from layer 20 to 30
errors.evidence: The Character Attention input line (solid blue) drops to approximately 0.5 at layer 21 and 27. The stated lower bound of 0.6 for the fluctuation is incorrect.

errors.text_span: The Character MLP input line begins at around 0.8 at layer 0, remains relatively stable until layer 10
errors.evidence: Describing the Character MLP input line (dashed blue) as 'relatively stable' until layer 10 is an over-generalization. The line visibly peaks near 0.93 around layer 4 and dips to 0.8 around layer 8.

errors.text_span: then increases to around 0.9 at layer 15
errors.evidence: The Character MLP input line (dashed blue) does not increase from layer 10. Instead, it drops sharply to a minimum of about 0.55 at layer 12 before recovering. The trend described is incorrect.

errors.text_span: and stays between 0.85 and 0.9 from layer 20 to 30
errors.evidence: For most of the range from layer 20 to 28, the Character MLP input line (dashed blue) is above 0.9, reaching up to ~0.95. Stating it stays between 0.85 and 0.9 is an underestimate.
The Wiki Attention input line (solid red) is at approximately 0.5 at layer 12. It reaches its minimum of about 0.38 at layer 14, not 0.3 at layer 12.

errors.text_span: The Wiki MLP input line begins at around 0.85 at layer 0
errors.evidence: The Wiki MLP input line (dashed red) begins at approximately 0.8, not 0.85.
Describing the Wiki MLP input line (dashed red) as 'relatively stable' until layer 10 is an over-generalization. The line visibly peaks around layer 5 (~0.88) and then dips to ~0.7 by layer 10.

errors.text_span: then increases to around 0.9 at layer 15
errors.evidence: The Wiki MLP input line (dashed red) does not increase from layer 10. Instead, it continues to drop to a minimum of about 0.62 at layer 13 before recovering. The trend described is incorrect, and the value at layer 15 is ~0.75, not 0.9.
